spans.s:
इज्य mfn. (-ज्यः-ज्या-ज्यं) A teacher.
 m. (-ज्यः) VṚHASPATI, the teacher
or Guru of the gods.
 f. (-ज्या)
 1. A gift, a donation.
 2. Sacrificing,
making offerings to the gods or manes.
 3. Worship, reverence.
 4.
Meeting, union.
 5. A cow.
 6. A bawd or procuress. R. यज् to sacri-
fice, &c. क्यप् aff.

इज्याशील m. (-लः) A frequent sacrificer.
 E. इज्या sacrifice, and शील to be
frequent, अच् aff.
